name: Projection-Induced Geometry Governance Registry

core_definition.canonical_statement: Geometry-like structure is treated as stabilized persistence behavior emerging within projection-reduced recursive aspect-binding domains.
core_definition.non_primitive_rule: Geometry-like structure is not primitive and must remain subordinate to ⇔R source relations.

geometry_like_classes.name: persistence_field
geometry_like_classes.definition: Projection-stabilized continuity structure retaining partial local coherence.

geometry_like_classes.name: admissibility_surface
geometry_like_classes.definition: Projection boundary separating locally admissible and non-admissible continuation patterns.

governance_rules.rule: Geometry-like structures must declare source_relation and projection_depth.
Geometry-like structures remain projection-derived and non-primitive.
No geometry-like structure may claim derivation of physical spacetime.
Stabilized persistence does not imply ontological independence.
Geometry-like persistence patterns must include loss accounting.

allowed_uses: Describing persistence structures emerging under projection reduction.
Relating orientation consistency to geometry-like persistence.
forbidden_uses: Treating geometry-like persistence as proof of GR.
Treating projection-induced structures as ontologically independent.
